name: Warm Potato & Bacon Salad
description: New potatoes dressed while still warm so they soak up the mustardy dressing, with crisp bacon and chives.
author: Recipes sample collection
recipeIngredient: 750 g new potatoes, halved if large
recipeInstructions:
1. Boil the potatoes in salted water for 15–20 minutes until tender.
2. Meanwhile, fry the bacon until crisp, then cut into pieces.
3. Whisk the shallot, mustard, vinegar and oil together and season.
4. Drain the potatoes and toss with the dressing while still hot.
5. Fold through the bacon and chives and serve warm.
